prompt: kubernetes OwnerReference blockOwnerDeletion missing permission error response
answer:
The error means the caller lacks permission to set the `finalizers` subresource on the resource referenced by the `ownerReference`. Grant the relevant RBAC permissions, including access to the resource’s `finalizers` subresource. The Operator SDK issue also notes that missing permission to create/view/edit deployments, `finalizers`, or services can cause this error.

Check permissions with:

```bash
kubectl auth can-i update <resource>/finalizers -n <namespace>
kubectl auth can-i create <resource> -n <namespace>
```

Relevant references:

- [Operator SDK issue](https://github.com/operator-framework/operator-sdk/issues/1736)
- [Kubernetes RBAC](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/rbac/)
